task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from hand-editing lockfiles and generated code, and tells them how to regenerate instead.","id":"gh:1420637308","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-protect-generated-files","slug":"acus9345/dsh-protect-generated-files","topics":["ai-agents","codegen","coding-agent","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","lockfile"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from hand-editing lockfiles and generated code, and tells "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"them how to regenerate instead."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-protect-generated-files"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Agents edit files that nobody should edit by hand. They'll patch a version number straight into `pnp"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"m-lock.yaml`, fix a typo in `user.pb.go`, or \"correct\" a type in Prisma's generated client. The edit"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" looks fine until the next `pnpm install` or `protoc` run wipes it out, or, worse, leaves the lockfi"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"le disagreeing with `package.json` in a way that takes an afternoon to untangle."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This DeepSeek Harness plugin refuses `write` and `edit` calls on generated files and lockfiles. It a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"lso refuses in-place shell edits of them (`sed -i`, `perl -pi`, `> file`, `tee file`). Instead of a "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"bare \"no\", the model is told how the file is supposed to change:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"That's the `web` profile, the browser UI you start with `dsh web`. If you run DSH another way, use `"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"headless` (scripts and CI) or `acp` (editor integrations) instead. Each profile keeps its own plugin"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" list, so add it to every profile you use. It's active right after installing. Remove it with `dsh p"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"lugin --profile web remove dsh-protect-generated-files`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### From a clone"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"To try local changes, build a tarball and install that:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## How it decides a file is generated"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"There are three ways a file gets flagged."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Lockfiles, by name.** `package-lock.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `yarn.lock`, `bun.lock(b)`, `deno.loc"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"k`, `Cargo.lock`, `go.sum`, `poetry.lock`, `uv.lock`, `pdm.lock`, `Pipfile.lock`, `Gemfile.lock`, `c"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"omposer.lock`, `mix.lock`, `pubspec.lock`, `Podfile.lock`, `flake.lock`, `gradle.lockfile`, `package"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"s.lock.json`, `conan.lock`. Each one comes with the right command for its own package manager, for e"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"xample \"change dependencies with `cargo add / cargo update -p <crate>`\"."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Known output paths.** Protobuf output (`*.pb.go`, `*_pb2.py`, ...), Dart `build_runner` output, `."},{"id":"p16s2","text":"Designer.cs`, minified files and source maps, and anything inside `node_modules/`, `__generated__/`,"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" `.venv/` or `site-packages/`. Build-output folders (`dist/`, `target/`, `.next/`, `vendor/` and so "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"on) only count when they sit next to a project manifest like `package.json`, `Cargo.toml` or `go.mod"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"`, so a source folder that happens to be called `target` isn't caught."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**A header that says so.** It reads the first 15 lines of the file and looks for `Code generated ..."},{"id":"p17s2","text":" DO NOT EDIT`, `@generated`, `DO NOT EDIT`, `auto-generated`, `This file was generated`, `<auto-gene"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"rated>`, or a `Generated by <tool>` comment. A header that says the file may be edited (\"edit freely"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"\", \"safe to edit\"), or a qualified `DO NOT EDIT without ...`, doesn't count. When the header names a"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" tool it knows, the hint names that tool too: protoc/buf, Prisma, GraphQL Codegen, OpenAPI generator"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"s, sqlc, `go generate`, Drizzle, Alembic, and others. \"Generated by hand\" and \"generated by ChatGPT\""},{"id":"p17s7","text":"generate`, Drizzle, Alembic, and others. \"Generated by hand\" and \"generated by ChatGPT\" don't count."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The header check only applies to files that already exist. The name and path rules also cover new fi"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"les, because a lockfile written by hand from scratch is just as wrong."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"On Windows, where DSH runs commands through PowerShell, it also watches `Set-Content`, `Add-Content`"},{"id":"p19s2","text":", `Out-File` and `Tee-Object`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## When a hand edit is right"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"It happens: resolving a lockfile merge conflict, or a one-line hotfix in vendored code while you wai"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"t for upstream. The model is told it can repeat the identical call once to confirm, and that goes th"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rough. Use `mode: ask` if you want to approve these yourself. If a directory is generated-looking bu"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"t actually hand-maintained, add it to `ignore`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The easy way: open **Plugins** in DSH's sidebar, click **dsh-protect-generated-files**, change what "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"you want and press **Save**. It applies to the next tool call, no restart needed."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Or add a row like this to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, or to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.y"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ml` for every profile. Keys you leave out keep their defaults."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`extraGlobs` is the one most worth setting. Telling the model which script regenerates your code sav"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"es it from guessing."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The install test runs `dsh plugin add`, which needs `pnpm` on your PATH."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"MIT licensed. Written by acus9345. Bug reports and ideas are welcome in the issues."}],"truncated":false}
